title: agent-crew task register
description: Slim per-task state pointer file. Lives at {TASK_DIR}/register.json. Introduced in Phase F4 alongside JSON-schema validation. Pointer-only: does NOT duplicate pipeline.json execution-graph content or per-stage handoff content.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bumped on incompatible field changes; readers tolerate higher versions with a warning.

session_id.description: {YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}. Derived from TASK_ID by stripping the -N suffix when not provided by orchestrator.

task.description: Original task description as passed to crew:run.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root. May be a worktree path in parallel mode.

project_name.description: Display name derived from the project root basename. Not used as the state directory key because duplicate basenames are possible.

project_state_key.description: Collision-safe state directory key: slug(project basename) plus a short hash of the canonical project root.

task_dir.description: Absolute path to {STATE_DIR}/tasks/{TASK_ID}. Self-referential; useful for tooling that received only register.json.

current_phase.description: Current supervisor phase. Updated at each phase boundary via the register_update helper. Terminal values: completed, blocked, cancelled.

approval_status.description: Approval gate state. not_required = pipeline has no gate, pending = at the gate, approved/cancelled = post-resolution.

verification_status.description: Reviewer stage state. running set at reviewer entry, passed/failed at reviewer exit, skipped when pipeline has no reviewer stage.

requirements_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/context/requirements.md. May not exist yet if Phase 1a has not run.

analysis_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/context/analysis.md. May not exist yet if Phase 1b has not run.

pipeline_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/pipeline.json. Resolved at task setup; the file itself is written by analyst in Phase 1b.

progress_buffer_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/progress.buffer.jsonl. Phase F5 structured event buffer.

result_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/result.md. Written by Phase 3 close-out.

approval_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/context/approval.md. Only populated for runs that hit Phase 2.5 approval gates.

start_head_path.description: Path to {TASK_DIR}/context/start-head.txt — pre-execution HEAD SHA recorded by Phase 1b+1c.

modified_files.description: Cumulative list of files modified by stage agents during this task. Appended at each STAGE_DONE; deduplicated. Populated from NUL-safe git status --porcelain=v1 -z output.

issue_comment_ingestion.description: Issue body/comment ingestion evidence pointers recorded before planning for tasks that reference external issue numbers.

path.description: Path to the issue ingestion evidence artifact.

comments_ingested.description: Whether issue comments were included in the evidence artifact.

comment_count.description: Number of issue comments recorded in the evidence artifact.

blocked_by.description: Reasons / blocker labels when current_phase=blocked. Empty otherwise. Multiple entries when multiple sub-causes apply (e.g., crash budget + cost budget).

repair_command.description: Operator command to reconcile state after a current-session manual handoff fallback.

host_bridge_status.description: Host bridge execution classification for distinguishing automatic completion, manual fallback, and true blocked handoffs.

host_bridge_completion_path.description: Path to host bridge invocation/completion evidence when an adapter bridge was attempted.

host_bridge_completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when an automatic host bridge completion was recorded.

host_bridge_failure_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for host bridge failure, such as bridge_timeout or bridge_reported_blocked.

host_bridge_stall_class.description: Optional finer classification for host bridge stall modes, such as no_output_startup_stall.

manual_fallback_repaired_at.description: UTC timestamp when crew repair reconciled a manual host-handoff fallback.

manual_fallback_repair_path.description: Path to context/manual-fallback-repair.json when a task was repaired after manual fallback completion.
